categories.main_business_segments: Harbin Fuerjia Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the professional skin care products industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of medical devices and functional skincare cosmetics. Its product portfolio includes medical dressings based on sodium hyaluronate and collagen, as well as a variety of functional skincare products such as masks, serums, lotions, sprays, and eye masks with effects like whitening, acne treatment, anti-wrinkle, and repair.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including supermolecular technology, synthetic biology, and innovative peptide technologies. It uses a combination of independent production, OEM, and commissioned processing, with strict quality management systems including 'four tests and ten safety checks' to ensure product safety and quality. The R&D approach integrates in-house innovation with collaborations with universities and research institutes, supported by dual R&D centers in Harbin and Shanghai.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include medical institutions, beauty clinics, chain pharmacies, cosmetic specialty stores, large supermarkets, and online consumers via major e-commerce platforms like Tmall, JD.com, Douyin, and Pinduoduo. The company targets consumers seeking professional skin care solutions, including those with skin barrier damage, acne, sensitivity, and post-laser treatment needs, primarily within the Chinese domestic market.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are concentrated in mainland China, with strategic regional focuses including Northeast China (Harbin), North China, East China (Shanghai and Hangzhou), South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest China. It has established subsidiaries and offices in Harbin and Shanghai to support regional market penetration and R&D activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Harbin Fuerjia Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, engaging in product R&D, manufacturing, and direct sales to end consumers and professional channels. It manages a comprehensive supply chain including raw material procurement, production, quality control, and multi-channel distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes a dual-track R&D strategy focusing on both medical devices (Class II and III) and functional cosmetics. It invests heavily in innovation, developing new raw materials such as NMN, acetyl curcumin, and modified peptides, and expanding product lines with advanced formulations and delivery systems. Collaboration with academic institutions and industry partners accelerates technology transfer and product commercialization. Digitalization of R&D processes and expansion of the R&D team are key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of medical devices and cosmetics via multiple channels. Sales occur through direct online sales (self-operated stores on major e-commerce platforms), distribution to dealers and agents, and offline sales through professional medical and cosmetic retail channels. The company also earns investment income from financial assets but primarily relies on product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the professional skin care segment, especially in patch-type skin care products in China. It competes with both domestic and international brands in the cosmetics and medical device sectors. Its competitive advantages include early market entry with sodium hyaluronate medical dressings, diversified product lines, strong brand recognition as a 'national brand light,' and extensive channel coverage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.02 billion, a 4.32% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 661 million, reflecting an 11.77% decrease. The company has total assets of around RMB 6.08 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 5.66 billion. It has shown steady revenue growth but faced profit pressure due to increased marketing and sales expenses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Harbin Fuerjia Technology differentiates itself through its focus on scientifically backed, functional skincare products combining medical device-grade efficacy with cosmetic appeal. It leverages proprietary technologies, patented formulations, and a dual R&D center model to innovate. The brand emphasizes safety, efficacy, and multi-functional skincare solutions tailored to diverse consumer needs, supported by strong marketing and a comprehensive sales network that integrates online and offline channels.
